subject: Trading
title: Spot, Forward, and Futures
description: Learn Spot, Forward, and Futures in one minute.

hook.text: You can trade currencies now, later, or at a locked-in price months from today. Three markets, one currency.

buildup.text: The spot market trades currencies at today's price with settlement in two business days.

discovery.text: Forwards are customized agreements to exchange at a set price on a future date—used heavily by corporations.

twist.text: Futures are like forwards but standardized and exchange-traded—transparent pricing but less flexibility.

climax.text: Each market serves a different need: speculation, hedging, or long-term planning for international business.

quiz.question: What is the main difference between a forward and a future in forex?
options: Forwards are customized; futures are standardized and exchange-traded
